native_mechanisms: A growing chain hung between fire and wall: every new shadow depends on the whole accumulated row, not just the newest knot (state-wide feedback into each step)
Each mark's own pebble-count (its stroke tally) sets how far the incense swings, bending the light before it lands (data-dependent rotation amount derived from the word's own bit-count)
Only the clay print of the settled shadow, hardened in the stream and read by its ridges, is kept as the token (final mixing/finalization, all intermediate state discarded)
core_technique: Multiplication-free six-lane ARX hash: each 8-byte word is added to its lane together with a cross-lane feedback word, then rotated left by (2*popcount(word) + per-lane constant), with lanes folded and passed through a Wang-style shift-add/xor finalizer.
